title: PIV_ADAI: a MATLAB GUI for image velocimetry and tracking of firebrands and particles
description: PIV_ADAI is a MATLAB application for the detection, tracking (PTV) and cross-correlation velocimetry (PIV) of firebrands and particles in image sequences and videos of fire experiments. It provides automatic or manual brightness/contrast adjustment, background subtraction, user-defined interrogation areas and overlap, and post-processing of velocity, direction, size, number density and streamlines. Developed at ADAI (Associação para o Desenvolvimento da Aerodinâmica Industrial) and CEIF (Centro de Estudos sobre Incêndios Florestais), Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Coimbra, Portugal.
